question: Will U.S. real GDP growth, quarter on quarter at an annual rate (BEA, chained dollars, seasonally adjusted; computed from the level) for Q4 2024 (the latest quarterly reading dated on or before 2024-10-13) be above 1.44%, its value for Q1 2024?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2024-07-15 (Q1 2024), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
